SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS category_cnt
FROM products;
message.reasoning_content:
The user asks: "商品类目一共有多少个？" - How many product categories in total?

We need to count distinct product_category_name from products. But there's a dimension policy: product_category_nulls_v1 — applies only when the field is used as grouping dimension. Here we're counting categories. Hmm. Counting categories - should we exclude NULL? Counting distinct categories: NULL is not a category value. The policy says default null policy excludes SQL NULL when used as grouping dimension. Counting distinct categories effectively treats each non-null value as a category. So count distinct product_category_name excludes NULLs automatically.

So: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products;

No LIMIT needed? It's a single-row aggregate without GROUP BY, so allowed exception. Yes, rule 3 exception.

Output column alias: maybe category_cnt.
